explanations.text: Residues 1-12 of chain A (12 residues) come from a file that was not declared to be a predicted model. Its B-factor column is therefore not read as pLDDT, and no model-confidence scores are reported for it. A designed backbone, for example, carries no confidence values of its own. Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.
